Cogentic Research Papers

This directory holds research papers that were produced by Cogentic.

Papers

November 25, 2026

  • Unconditional Integer Factorization in Time L_N[1/3, O(1)] (PDF)
  • Discrete Logarithms in Finite Fields of Fixed Characteristic in Sub-Quasi-Polynomial Time (PDF)
  • An Exact Polynomial-Time Algorithm for 1/5-Approximate Nash Equilibria in Bimatrix Games (PDF)
  • Unconditional Deterministic Subexponential Integer Factoring and Quadratic Nonresidue Construction (PDF)
  • Breaking the Square-Root Barrier for the Log-Rank Conjecture (PDF)
  • Unconditional Edge Reconstruction of Simple Graphs of Linear Density (PDF)

November 23, 2026

  • Nearly Tight O(log log log m) Prophet Inequalities for Subadditive Combinatorial Auctions (PDF)
  • Polynomial Dimension Dependence for Fictitious Play Convergence (PDF)

November 18, 2026

  • Near-Quadratic Sample Compression for All VC Classes (PDF)

October 30, 2026

  • Intractability of Approximate Correlated Equilibria in Two-Player Convex Games (PDF)

License

Unless otherwise noted in individual subdirectories, the contents in this directory are released under the Apache 2.0 license. See individual subdirectories and the top-level google-research repository for details.

Disclaimer: This is not an official Google product.
